name: Sophie Dubois
bio:
Sophie Dubois's journey into motorsport finance was somewhat unconventional. After graduating with a degree in economics, she initially worked in corporate finance, but a lifelong passion for racing led her to seek opportunities within the motorsport industry. She joined a smaller rally team, learning the ropes of motorsport finance from the ground up, before moving to EKS JC three years ago.

As finance controller, Sophie is meticulous and detail-oriented, ensuring that the team's budget is managed effectively and that financial risks are minimized. She prides herself on her ability to identify areas where costs can be reduced without compromising performance. Her big-picture thinking and understanding of the sport's unique financial challenges make her an invaluable asset to EKS JC. She's known for her ability to find creative solutions to complex financial problems, always striving to optimize the team's financial position.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back into a neat ponytail.
physical.description: Sophie is of average height with a thoughtful and focused expression.

quirks: Always has a spreadsheet open, even during team meetings.
Insists on using a fountain pen for signing important documents.
Keeps a small lucky charm (a miniature racing car) on her desk.
